task: Indexable skip list sorted map (ae.skip.SkipListMap) with rank/select/countRange via link spans, differential-tested against TreeMap
reasoning_summary: Each forward link stores a span so rank and select walk the levels in expected O(log n). Header spans for unused levels track size+1 so growing the height needs no special case. A package-private checkInvariants() plus a TreeMap differential test after every mutation validated it; the one failure was a wrong hand-written expectation in the test.
